title: Add structured per-token metrics exporter and OTEL log enrichment for traces
author: Lina Wu
commits: proto: add TokenEvent proto and metrics schema
telemetry: implement structured token metrics exporter (OTLP + prometheus bridge)
runtime: emit token events at generation boundary with sampling/priority tags
logs: enrich OTEL log records with token-level fields and hashed prompt id
tests: unit/integration tests for exporter and enrichment
chore: fix lint and race in telemetry mock
description:
Summary: Adds a new opt-in structured per-token metrics exporter and OTEL log enrichment to attach token-level fields to traces and logs. Motivation: token-level visibility is necessary to diagnose long-tail latency/cost regressions (esp. when batching and KV cache interactions differ by request priority). Existing token cost/latency buckets cover aggregated cases but do not preserve per-token attributes (model, priority_tier, cache_hit, prompt_hash). This PR provides a low-overhead, sampled event stream and a Prometheus bridge for aggregated consumption.

What changed (high level): 1) telemetry.proto: new TokenEvent proto describing timestamp, model, token_index, token_type (prompt/response), priority_tier, cache_hit, sequence_len, approximate_cost_micros, hashed_prompt_id, and sample_reason. 2) token_exporter: an exporter that accepts TokenEvent and can push to OTLP collector or aggregate counters/gauges via a Prometheus bridge. Exporter supports sampling policies (always, head-only, uniform n/sample, priority-weighted) configured in config/flags. 3) runtime instrumentation: generation emits TokenEvent at token finalization; emission path is non-blocking and uses a ring buffer + background flusher to avoid adding tail latency. 4) OTEL log enrichment: log_enricher attaches token-related attributes to the existing request-scoped OTEL logs and spans when sampling is enabled. To avoid PII risks we only include hashed_prompt_id; raw prompt text is never emitted. 5) Dashboards & alerts: new Grafana panels and an alert bundle that surface per-model token latency histograms, stream of sample reasons, and cardinality metrics. 6) Tests & docs: unit/integration tests added; docs describe feature flag, retention guidance, and cost implications.

Backward/compatibility notes: feature is behind the config flag telemetry.token_events.enabled=false by default. Exporter uses OTLP protocol; when disabled the codepath is no-op. No breaking API changes. Migration: operators who enable the exporter should size their telemetry collector for event rate; we include example sampling configs in docs.

Checklist: - [x] proto and exporter implementation - [x] runtime emit + non-blocking flusher - [x] OTEL log enrichment (opt-in) - [x] dashboards and example alert rules - [x] unit and integration tests - [x] docs and config entries - [x] performance validation: microbenchmark on p99 tail showed <0.25ms median additional latency in sampled mode

Commit summary: see commits list. Files changed: see files_changed list above. Small snippets: - telemetry.proto adds TokenEvent message and TokenSampleReason enum. - emitter writes events to telemetry/token_exporter.go via EmitTokenEvent(ctx, event).

Testing performed: unit tests for exporter serialization and prom-bridge aggregation; integration test that spins up a mock OTLP collector and asserts receipt for sampled events; CI e2e telemetry job that ran against a small serve binary and validated enriched OTEL logs and metrics; load microbenchmark (scripts/telemetry/load_test) at 10k rps with 1% sampling to validate CPU and memory overhead.

Security & privacy: raw prompt text is explicitly excluded; only hashed_prompt_id (HMAC-SHA256 with instance key) is emitted. The feature will appear in the privacy review checklist (ENG-8791). Operator docs include guidance for rotating keys and retention limits.

Open follow-ups: - Add adaptive sampling policy based on queue depth (ENG-8820) - Integrate exporter with billing pipeline to derive token-level cost telemetry (follow-up PR) - Add per-tenant rolloff in Dedicated deployments to avoid noisy tenants

release_notes: Opt-in structured per-token telemetry: operators can enable telemetry.token_events to export sampled per-token events to OTLP or aggregate them via the Prometheus bridge. This enables detailed token-level diagnostics (latency, cache_hit, priority tier) and enriched OTEL logs. Defaults off. See docs/observability/token-metrics.md for config and sizing guidance.
